question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (AMD)

calls.reasoning: Consensus Q3 2026 non-GAAP EPS ~$1.94-1.95 (rev guide $13B±0.3B, non-GAAP GM 56%); AMD usually beats modestly -> ~$2.00. GAAP-to-non-GAAP gap ex-investment items: amortization ~$540M + SBC ~$520M less tax effect ≈ $0.57-0.60/share (Q1'26: 1.37 vs 0.84). Q2's GAAP $1.38 had a $483M (+$0.29) investment gain, not assumed to recur. Central GAAP ≈ $1.42. Main risks: mark-to-market on $1.1B newly public stakes plus $1.7B private stakes (either direction), and a possible OpenAI/Meta warrant charge (liability-classified, none vested at Q2) as MI450 shipments begin — the low tail below $0.995. No Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold/bookmaker market found.
